decisions.text: Previous-desk momentum buy with no news case; analyst and skeptic agree there is no catalyst, buzz 0/3, volume 0.6x, bearish sector. Rule says sell a stock bought with no news case.

No company-specific catalyst at all; analyst and skeptic agree. Up 27.5% over 20 sessions but rolling over (-2.3% 5d, -1.7% today) on 0.4x volume. Stretched momentum with nothing fresh.

Moody's upgrade to Ba2 on rapid post-merger deleveraging is a fresh company-specific catalyst, and the stock leads the sector today (+5.2%) on 1.3x volume within a broad crude-driven energy rally. (weight 2)

Q3 call highlights a higher outlook and record earnings, a genuine company-specific beat-and-raise catalyst paired with the crude tailwind, though only 0.8x volume and one Reddit mention warrant a smaller size. (weight 2)
Completed $6B Castrol stake sale genuinely strengthens the balance sheet and rides a sector with 74% of names up; volume is light at 0.7x, so a modest position is appropriate. (weight 1)
